extracted.name: Gold Fever Chicken Wing Sauce
extracted.description: Honey mustard and hot sauce combine in this spicy chicken-wing sauce.
instruction_lines: Combine honey mustard, hot sauce, butter, salt, and black pepper in a saucepan over medium heat; stir until butter melted. Simmer until sauce begins to thicken, about 5 minutes. Use in your favorite chicken wings recipe and serve while hot.
